title: Implementation Tasks
description: Phased implementation task list for a feature. Tasks are organized into sequential phases with parallelism markers and full traceability back to spec.yaml requirements.

feature.description: Feature slug matching the feature package directory name.

version.description: SemVer version of this task list.

status.description: Current = aligned with design. Stale = design changed. Implemented = all tasks done.

source_design_version.description: Version of design.adoc used to derive tasks. 'n/a' if design was skipped.

source_spec_version.description: Version of spec.yaml used to derive tasks.

last_updated.description: Date of last update in YYYY-MM-DD format.

overview.description: Brief summary of what is being implemented, number of phases, total tasks.

phases.description: Sequential implementation phases. Phases are executed in order.

id.description: Unique task ID (e.g., 'TASK-001'). Sequential across the entire file.

done.description: Whether this task has been completed.

execution.description: parallel = no dependency on other tasks in this phase. sequential = must complete before next sequential task.

components.description: Design components involved. Omit when no design exists (source_design_version is 'n/a').

stories.description: Story IDs this task contributes to.

description.description: What to implement and key details.
